title: Austin Fire Department Building & City Budget Approved
summary:
• **Fire Station Funding Approved**: Council voted to spend $1,500 to complete a new engine and truck house for the fire department, though the measure was contentious with 4 aldermen voting against it.

• **General City Budget Passed**: Aldermen approved a $5,220.37 appropriation bill that included city operational expenses and printing costs for council meeting minutes.

• **Business License Changes**: Council unanimously passed an ordinance allowing the transfer of occupation licenses between businesses, streamlining local commerce rules.

• **Market House Renovation**: The council considered (but didn't finalize) a $175 payment to architect A.M.C. Nixon for designing renovations to the city's public market house.
